items.title: Hadjar returns to Red Bull for Baku after signing a 2027 extension
items.summary: Hadjar returns after missing Zandvoort, Monza and Madrid with a wrist fracture and has renewed with Red Bull for 2027. He says the simulator test went well but expects some continuing pain. Lawson returns to Racing Bulls and Tsunoda reverts to reserve.
items.why_it_matters: Baku's confirmed Red Bull/Racing Bulls line-up is the regular Verstappen-Hadjar pairing plus Lawson at Racing Bulls; do not carry the previous replacement chain into session results or teammate comparisons.

items.title: Antonelli's title lead remains the central Baku storyline
items.summary: Formula1.com's 23 September preview records Antonelli's consecutive Monza and Madrid wins and an 81-point lead over Russell after Madrid. Nine Grands Prix and the Singapore Sprint remained, offering 233 points. An earliest Singapore title requires every rival to be out of reach, not merely Russell scoring zero.
items.why_it_matters: Use the refreshed official standings for the exact gap and keep the title narrative live: Russell and Hamilton have not mathematically been removed from the season, despite Antonelli's substantial lead.

items.title: Williams brings its long-awaited FW48 upgrade package to Baku
items.summary: Formula1.com and The Race report that Williams is bringing its delayed FW48 package to Azerbaijan. Alex Albon and Carlos Sainz expect a step but caution that it may not deliver the full gain calculated months ago while the midfield continued to develop.
items.why_it_matters: This is a round-specific upgrade to watch in practice and qualifying, not proof of a guaranteed leap into Q3; compare the team's actual Baku pace with its own expectations.

items.title: Ocon says he is a 2027 free agent; Haas discussions continue
items.summary: Ocon told Wednesday's Baku media session he is a free agent for next season while discussions continue. Bearman expects to stay at Haas but says the final decision is not his. Neither statement announces a signed 2027 Haas line-up.
items.why_it_matters: This affects the driver-market story, not the confirmed current race pairing. Keep reported exit expectations separate from a team contract announcement.

items.title: Baku's aero zones, energy exceptions and tyre warm-up set the practice agenda
items.summary: The FIA map distinguishes two Straight Mode zones from the separate Overtake aid, with later low-grip activation. The energy sheet includes qualifying-only exceptions and a provisional absolute activation distance. Pirelli expects low wear but warns of front-tyre cooling before T1.
items.why_it_matters: The Circuit, Power Unit and Tyres pages now interpret the source tables. Do not describe recharge as deployment, treat the TBC as final, or assume a cold-front lock-up is a brake failure.
